caption: Scanu
name: scanu
description: Scanu extension attributes, carried under the OCSF `unmapped.scanu` object until the extension is registered.

ml_model_version.description: Version of the edge model that produced ml_score.

bloom_hit.description: SHA-256 present in the local known-bad bloom filter.

canary_id.description: Identifier of the ransomware canary that was touched.

freeze_tier.description: 1 if a Tier-1 freeze was applied locally, else 0.

process_start_time_ms.description: Process creation time (unix ms); with pid forms a reuse-safe process key.

beacon_jitter.description: Coefficient of variation of connection intervals for a (pid, remote) pair.
